verdict.rationale: Archived docs once described per-user service tokens scoped to connections whose metadata.userId matched a given user, along with managed OAuth credentials. Smithery's own shutdown notice says the Smithery API, Connect, accounts and API keys stopped working on October 31, 2026, leaving only a public, non-proxied registry. The product therefore no longer delivers per-end-user connected accounts or scoped tokens.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can maintain separate connected accounts and scoped tokens per end user of my product, so each user's agent acts only on that user's credentials
